conversation.text: Why is Arsenal controlling the match?

Arsenal are controlling the match through high and coordinated pressure, winning the ball in advanced areas and preventing Manchester City from building consistent attacks. Their compact shape, aggressive ball-near pressing and quick transitions are creating a sustained attacking threat, while limiting City to low-quality chances.

tacticalStory.description: Arsenal press high in a 4-3-3 shape, with the front three blocking City's central passing lanes and forcing play wide. When City go long, Arsenal's midfield and full-backs shift quickly to win second balls. These high regains are leading to fast, decisive attacks, as seen in the 64' goal. City are struggling to progress through midfield and are being forced into low-percentage passes, resulting in fewer entries into Arsenal's box.
